ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the rider's threat; preserve the chat log and trip record; do not auto-adjudicate any fare item. Notify the driver of the RydeHELP reporting path and of the option to report to police (999) if he feels unsafe, and record the rider's conduct on the account for monitoring pending human assessment.
ruling.reasoning: Safety screen (SAFE-1). The dispute type is "safety", filed by the driver, and the record contains a threat made against the driver by the rider in the in-app chat: at 18:24:05 the driver wrote "Please do not smoke in the car." (an ordinary, lawful request, not an arrangement or a provocation) and at 18:24:35 the rider replied "Say that again and I will punch you." That is a threat of physical harm aimed at the other party — hostile/abusive language, intimidation — which Ryde's Code of Conduct bars ("Assault, harassment, or abuse of any kind will not be tolerated … Threats and Intimidation"). The driver's statement is corroborated by the chat timestamp and content, not merely asserted. This is a threat read in full context (no pickup arrangement or other benign reading plausibly applies), so safety_concern = "confirmed" and the case must not be auto-adjudicated; SAFE-1 requires escalate with a factual summary for a human reviewer. No traffic accident, injury or dangerous-driving allegation appears in the record, so SAFE-2 is not engaged; no bodily harm occurred during the trip (dropoff 18:28:15, 3.7 min after the message), so this is a threat/intimidation matter rather than a medical one. Because the safety screen disposes of the case, I make no fare finding: the fare is a metered RydeTAXI total of $20.75 (base 3.90 + distance 11.93 on 8.46 km + time 3.34 on 12.83 min + waiting 0.11 + platform 1.47), and the route/off-route analysis is not adjudicated here because doing so would pre-empt the pending human review of a safety incident. I note for the human reviewer that the GPS trace and the quoted polyline track each other (no meaningful off-route deviation, no traffic incidents recorded, fair weather, speed bands 4/5 i.e. free-flow), so there is no apparent fare irregularity to unwind in parallel; the $0.11 waiting fee is a metered waiting unit, not the $5 published waiting fee, and no cancellation or edit-destination fee was charged. Evidence status is sufficient — GPS, timeline, fare, chat and both statements are present and internally consistent; the only matter that cannot be settled is the credibility weight and account action, which is precisely what a human must decide.
ruling.escalation_reason: Confirmed safety incident under SAFE-1: the rider threatened to punch the driver after being asked not to smoke, evidenced by the in-app chat (18:24:05 driver request; 18:24:35 rider threat) and corroborated by the driver's statement. Threat/intimidation and abuse of any kind are barred by Ryde's Code of Conduct; automatic adjudication is suspended and the matter is referred to a human reviewer, with the 995 / driver's commercial motor insurance / RydeHELP reporting paths noted for the driver. No fare refund is issued pending that review.

A verified threat of violence in the chat cannot be disposed of as no_action; Ryde's code of conduct bars abuse of any kind and requires human handling (SAFE-1).
